Move the nozzle in a sweeping motion, covering the entire floor systematically. The heated water helps break down and lift away dirt, leaving your crawlspace floor refreshed and free from contaminants. The high pressure helps dislodge and lift dirt, while the application of heat aids in dissolving grease, oil, and other difficult-to-remove substances. This method is efficient for cleaning exterior walls, floors, and other hard surfaces, providing a thorough and often more effective cleaning compared to cold-water pressure washing. It's commonly used in industrial, commercial, and residential settings to achieve deep cleaning and sanitization without the need for harsh chemicals.

name: Hydro Armor Shield Epoxy Crack and Floor Sealant
description: High-Strength Epoxy Penetrating Sealant for Concrete Cracks, Floor Stabilization, and Moisture Intrusion Prevention Hydro Armor Shield Epoxy Crack and Floor Sealant is a professional-grade two-component epoxy system designed to permanently seal structural and non-structural cracks in concrete while providing a durable, moisture-resistant protective layer across floor surfaces. This advanced epoxy formulation penetrates deep into existing cracks and porous concrete substrates, bonding internally to restore structural integrity and prevent further deterioration caused by water infiltration, freeze-thaw cycles, or hydrostatic pressure. Once applied, the epoxy forms a rigid, high-strength bond that stabilizes cracked concrete and seals pathways where moisture, vapor, or contaminants may otherwise penetrate. This system is commonly utilized in basement floors, crawlspace slabs, garage floors, mechanical rooms, utility areas, and other concrete surfaces exposed to moisture or structural stress. Hydro Armor Shield Epoxy Crack and Floor Sealant is engineered to deliver exceptional adhesion to properly prepared concrete surfaces, creating a seamless protective barrier that resists water intrusion, chemical exposure, and surface abrasion. Its low-viscosity penetrating properties allow the material to flow into fine cracks and voids, ensuring a complete seal and long-term durability. This epoxy sealing system is capable of resisting hydrostatic pressure up to 3,000 PSI, providing a powerful defense against water intrusion in below-grade environments where groundwater pressure and moisture migration are common concerns. Hydro Armor Shield Epoxy Crack and Floor Sealant is ideal for both preventative concrete protection and restoration applications where cracks, minor structural movement, or surface degradation have occurred. By reinforcing and sealing the concrete substrate, this system helps extend the service life of the structure while improving resistance to moisture damage. When installed as part of a comprehensive waterproofing or moisture control system, Hydro Armor Shield Epoxy Crack and Floor Sealant provides a reliable solution for maintaining dry, stable, and structurally sound concrete surfaces in residential and commercial environments.

name: Hydro Armor Shield Fortify Waterproofing Compound(Block Repair Mortor)

name: Hydro Armor Shield Heavy-Duty Flood Compound (Water stop)
description: Hydro Armor Shield Heavy-Duty Flood Compound an is exceptional cement-based solution that exhibits remarkable reactivity and sets rapidly. This advanced product demonstrates outstanding efficacy in swiftly sealing active water leaks upon application of the dry powder, effectively preventing further water ingress within mere seconds. It is particularly ideal for deployment alongside the esteemed Hydro Armor Shield Waterproofing Compound and Hydro Armor Shield Sentinel Waterproofing Seal, forming a comprehensive negative side waterproofing system specifically designed for cementitious surfaces, including internal basement structures. The integration of the highly reactive fast setting cementitious product with the Hydro Armor Shield System yields remarkable outcomes. By harnessing the combined power of these innovative solutions, flowing water is effectively halted, ensuring the creation of a permanent, impenetrable waterproof layer on various masonry and concrete surfaces. This holistic approach guarantees reliable and long-lasting protection against water damage, enabling successful internal basement waterproofing and other cementitious applications.

name: Hydro Armor Shield Sentinel Waterproofing Seal( Crack Filler )
description: Hydro Armor Shield Sentinel Waterproofing Seal presents a rapid-curing, expanding plug and repair mortar designed to effectively address water-related issues. By swiftly curing and expanding, the mortar establishes a strong connection between the underlying surface and itself. This capability enables the prompt sealing of pressurized leaks and leaking cracks, ensuring swift and efficient resolution.

name: Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant( Crack Injection )
description: Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant is a unique solution that exhibits dual characteristics depending on the conditions it encounters. When in contact with water, it functions as a single component injection resin, swiftly reacting to form a remarkably flexible foam. This foam demonstrates excellent elasticity, enabling it to accommodate crack movements and effectively seal them without the need for subsequent injections. Moreover, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant retains its elasticity even after the reaction occurs. Conversely, under dry conditions, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant operates as a two-component injection resin. This versatile formulation can effectively address cracks, providing a long-lasting solution. It transforms into an elastic polyurethane solid resin, which adheres tightly to the crack surfaces, preventing further leakage and permanently sealing the cracks. By combining these two resins into a single product, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant offers both short-term leak closure capabilities through its fast-reacting foam and a durable, elastic solid resin for the permanent closure of cracks. It ensures efficient and reliable results for various applications. Furthermore, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproof 2 Part Crack Sealant is free from solvents and exhibits excellent resistance to hydrolysis. These qualities make it an environmentally friendly and reliable choice for sealing and waterproofing purposes.

name: Hydro Armor Shield Waterproofing Compound(Waterproofing Product)
description: Watertight Cementitious Waterproofing Solution for High Water Pressure Environments (> 400 ft water head) with Crystallizing Agents We present a highly effective and durable waterproofing solution that is capable of withstanding extreme water pressure conditions exceeding 400 ft water head. This innovative system combines the power of cementitious materials with subsequently crystallizing agents, providing exceptional waterproofing performance for both positive side and negative side applications. Our waterproofing product, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproofing Compound, has been specifically engineered to deliver outstanding results in terms of pressure resistance and abrasion protection. It is an ideal choice for various construction projects, including new construction and restoration projects such as basement waterproofing and tank lining. One of the key advantages of Hydro Armor Shield Waterproofing Compound is its certification to NSF/ANSI 61 standards, ensuring that it meets the stringent requirements for use in contact with potable water. This certification guarantees the product's safety and suitability for applications where water quality is of utmost importance. By employing our watertight cementitious waterproofing system, you can have complete confidence in the long-term integrity and durability of your structures. Whether it's preventing water ingress in basements or protecting tanks from leaks, Hydro Armor Shield Waterproofing Compound provides a reliable and high-performance solution. Trust in our innovative waterproofing technology to safeguard your construction projects against water-related challenges.

The product can penetrate into the substrate to a depth of up to 2", depending on the specific surface. name: Wifi Pump Monitorinf
description: Supply and installation of a WiFi-enabled sump pump monitoring and tracking system intended to enhance basement and crawlspace water intrusion protection through continuous operational monitoring and remote alert capabilities. Scope of work includes installation of monitoring hardware, integration with existing sump pump system, configuration of wireless network connectivity, calibration and testing of sensors/float detection components, and setup of mobile application and/or customer notification platform when applicable. System is designed to monitor and report critical sump system conditions including, but not limited to: High water level alerts Pump activation frequency and runtime tracking Power interruption or outage notifications WiFi communication loss notifications Abnormal pump cycling or excessive run-time conditions Potential pump failure or non-activation events Backup system status monitoring where compatible Installation includes verification of proper communication between monitoring device and connected network, functional testing of alarm and notification systems, and confirmation of sensor operation at time of installation. Monitoring platform may provide remote access to sump system activity, historical performance data, and automated alerts via mobile device, email, or SMS depending on manufacturer capabilities and customer-selected services. Contractor will make reasonable efforts to optimize wireless signal performance at the installation location; however, consistent operation of remote monitoring features is dependent upon customer-provided internet service, router performance, power availability, and sufficient WiFi signal strength within the structure. Any required network modifications, additional extenders, electrical upgrades, subscription fees, or third-party monitoring services are excluded unless specifically noted within this estimate. This system serves as an early warning and monitoring aid only and does not guarantee prevention of flooding, water intrusion, equipment failure, or property damage. Regular inspection and maintenance of the sump pump system remain the responsibility of the property owner.
